correctness.rationale: The six matrix-square equations follow from characteristic-two matrix multiplication. All q=2^f follow symbolically, not from extrapolation.

value.rationale: At n=5 in characteristic two the square image first becomes a proper subset of the commutator subgroup. Exact counts at every prescribed central target, the entire fiber multiplicity distribution, and the uniform square-image polynomial provide a complete nontrivial invariant for the standard 5-by-5 unitriangular family. It exceeds known structural width/image statements and the classical identity zero-square count; it is not an arbitrary slice or a small numerical increment.
